comparison.objective: Riddle sparkling-wine bottles by controlled one-eighth turns in a rack; candidate commissions an industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Grasp and incrementally rotate bottles while maintaining rack placement versus loosen-adjust-relock manipulation and dynamic carriage testing.
comparison.success_condition: Required bottles remain correctly turned and seated versus two consecutive safe stops with retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: The bottle task tests indexed container rotation, not tool-mediated adjustment of energy absorption.
